paite: Theophilas aw, tuma a ka laigelh ah, Jesu thilhih leh athuhilh pat tung tengteng thu ka gelh hi.
heading: Thumakai

paite: Kha Siangthou tawn a asawltak telte kiang a thupiak tampi apiak khit a van a pitouh a a-om ni tan a thute ahi.
Huai sawltakte kiang ah gimna athuak nung in theihna zuau lou tampi in ahing in akimusak a, ni sawmli hial akiang uah akilak a, Pathian lalgam thu agen hi.
Huan a-omkhawm uh akithuahpih a, "Jerusalem khua paisan kei un, Pa thilchiam ka gen na zak uh ngak un, achi tinten hi.
Johan in tui in abaptis zel a, himahleh, ni sawt lou nung in Kha Siangthou a baptis in na om ding uh," achi hi.
Huan amaute ahong kikhop un akiang ah, "Toupa, tu in hia Israelte kiang a lalgam na piak nawn ding?" chi in adong uhi.
heading: Jesu Vankahna / (Mar 16.19-20; Luk 24.50-53)

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Pa in ahun leh ani amah thuthu a om dia aseh, nou theih ding ahi kei hi.

Himahleh, Kha Siangthou na tung ua ahong tun chiang in thilhihtheihna na nei ding uh; huchi in Jerusalem ah, leh Judia gamsung pumpi ah, leh Samaria leh kawlmong pha in ka theihpihte na hi ding uh," achi hi.
Huai thu agen khit in amuh laipi un, van a pitouh in a-omta a, meipi in amuh phak louh uah apitouta hi.
Huan apaitouh lai a van lam a-et nilouh lai un, ngai in, mi nih, puanngou silh in, akiang uah ahong dingh uhi.
Huai mite'n, "Galili gam a mite aw, bangziak a van lam en a dingh na hi ua? Hiai Jesu na kiang ua kipan a van apitouh a om, van a paitou na muh bang un amah mah ahong kik nawn ding," achi uhi.
Huan Olive tang achih ua kipat Jerusalem ah akik nawnta uhi. Huai tang Jerusalem kho kiang ahi a, Sabbath ni a hohna hun lel ahi.
heading: Nungzuite Kithuahkhawmna

paite: Huan alut un, a-omna dantan tungnung uah apaitou ua, Peter leh Johan, Jakob leh Andru, Philip leh Thomas, Bartholomai leh Matthai, Alphai tapa Jakob, Simon Zealot Pawl a leh Jakob tapa Judas toh ahi uh.
Huai tengteng numei kuate hiam leh Jesu nu Mari toh, Jesu unaute toh, lungsim mun khat a, phatuamngaitak a thum in a-om nilouh uhi.
Huan huai ni in unaute lak ah Peter adingh a, avek un za-le-sawmnih ahi uhi.
heading: Mathia Sehna / (Mat 27.7-8)

paite: "Unaute aw, Kha Siangthou in, David kam a, Jesu mante makai Judas thu agenkholh Laisiangthou thu ahong tung ding him ahi."
Amah zaw i lak ua simtel ahi a, hiai nasepna ah tan leng anei sam hi.
Himahleh huai mi'n akhelhna man in mun khat alei a, akhuplam in akia a, alai ah apuakkham a, agil tengteng alawt vek hi.
Huai thu Jerusalem a omte tengteng in ana za uhi; huchi in huai mun amau pau in, Akeldama, achi ua, huai tuh Sisan Mun, chihna ahi.
"Sam Laibu ah hiai thu gelh ahi. 'A-omna mun hihgam in om hen, asung ah kuamah om kei hen,' 'huan aheutu hihna midang in tang hen,' chih ahi.
"Huchi in Toupa Jesu i lak ua lut zel pawt zel a a-om sung teng a,
Johan baptisma nungsiah, i lak ua kipan van a pitouh a a-om ni tan hiai hon kithuahpihte lak a mi khat athohnawnna theihpih ding in a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan mi nih asepkhia ua, khat Joseph Barsabbas kichi ahi a, aminkhem Justas leh midang khat Mathias ahi.
Huan athum ua, "Toupa, Nang, mihing tengteng lungtang thei, hiai nihte akua zaw pen ahia na tel hon hilh in,
Judas in amah omna a pai ding in hiai nasepna leh sawltakna akiaksan sik a ding in," achi uhi.
Huan ai asan ua, a-aisan uh Matthias tung ah atu a; huchi in amah sawltak sawm-le-khatte lak a simtel ahita hi.
